arguments:
{"script":"cat > sum_sizes.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash

dir="sample_directory"
if [ ! -d "$dir" ]; then
  echo 0
  exit 0
fi

find "$dir" -maxdepth 1 -type f -printf '%s\n' | awk '{s+=$1} END{print s+0}'
EOF

chmod +x sum_sizes.sh

./sum_sizes.sh
"}
